== Notes ==

* Its ''slow moving arrow'' always follows a high arc: it can be easily avoided at long distances and is unaffected by [[Read the Wind]] and [[Favorable Winds]], which flatten the path of the arrow. This makes it more effective against nearby targets or those that are [[snare (tactic)|snared]].
* Bow choice makes no difference on flight time for this particular skill.
* [[NPC]]s will use this skill on foes wielding a [[spellcasting weapon]], but will only target those wielding a martial weapon if they are activating a spell.

== Trivia ==
